resources.string: Fast Lightning payments, ready when you are. No setup needed.
Connect your Blink account with an API key.
Connect a compatible wallet using its NWC connection link.
Import your Spark wallet with its recovery phrase.
Go back to Rayl in Settings before connecting another wallet.
Finish connecting your wallet, then reopen the payment request.
Rayl could not finish clearing the previous wallet connection. Retry to continue.
Wait for the current payment to finish, then open the link again.
